attributes.title: 2027 AACN Doctoral Education Conference
attributes.organizer: American Association of Colleges of Nursing
attributes.summary:
The American Association of Colleges of Nursing holds its 2027 Doctoral Education Conference from January 12 to 14, 2027, at the Hotel del Coronado on Coronado Island, across the bay from San Diego. It is meant for deans, directors and faculty who teach in PhD and DNP programs and for nurses who lead research programs.

On January 11 there are a PhD pre-conference and a faculty practice pre-conference, the Research Leadership Network program follows on January 12, and a workshop on moving curricula to competency-based education with AI runs January 14 and 15. Attendees earn NCPD credit; AACN has not published the number of hours.

Early registration runs through December 12: $699 for AACN members, $899 for non-members and $350 for full-time students, rising to $799, $999 and $400. Room blocks at the Hotel del Coronado (from $409 plus a resort charge) and the Glorietta Bay Inn (from $199 plus a resort charge) close December 9 and 10, 2026.
